output.summary: Arts' 9-day median is mostly a SlotBook effect. RR-17 sends 1,610 tickets to a P4 best-effort queue, with a 17-day wait before first action, and removing them closes about 70% of the gap. Much of the remainder comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist, which Education shares. Category-matched Arts tickets resolve at about the same speed as other faculties' tickets, and duplicate and trivial rates are normal, so there is no evidence of deprioritisation or of trivial-ticket filing. Requesters received a content-free acknowledgement. Whether Arts was told of RR-17 is unestablished. The link between the SSO migration and SlotBook tickets is confounded by term start and the new category. Preferred action is a written support agreement for SlotBook, a corrected P4 acknowledgement, and split reporting. A blanket P4 track would be harmful. Moving to CampusBook now or setting up an Arts desk is premature.
